title: Indian Army CSBO Recruitment 2026 - 190 Civilian Posts, 10th Pass Can Apply Before May 31
author: Ash K.
excerpt: Ministry of Defence has released 190 Civilian Switch Board Operator (CSBO) Grade II vacancies in the Indian Army. 10th pass with PBX experience eligible. Apply via email before May 31, 2026. Pay Level 3 - Rs 21,700 basic.
body: The Ministry of Defence, through HQ 2 Signal Training Centre in Panaji, Goa, has released a recruitment notification for 190 Civilian Switch Board Operator (CSBO) Grade II posts in the Indian Army. The notification was published in Employment News dated May 2-8, 2026, and applications are accepted via email until May 31, 2026.

This is a Group C civilian post under the Ministry of Defence - you work as a civilian employee inside Army establishments, operating telephone exchange systems and communication equipment. The job offers the security of a central government position with the unique experience of working within the Indian Army's signaling and communication network.

Educational qualification is Matriculation (10th pass) from a recognized board with minimum 6 months of experience in handling PBX (Private Branch Exchange) or EPABX boards. Age limit is 18-25 years with standard relaxation for reserved categories. The selection process includes a written test, practical test on PBX handling, and interview.

Starting salary is Pay Level 3 under 7th CPC - Rs 21,700 basic pay. With DA, HRA, transport allowance, and other benefits, total monthly compensation is approximately Rs 33,000-40,000. As a central government employee in the Defence establishment, you also get CGHS medical coverage, canteen facilities, and pension benefits.

callout.heading: How to apply - email-based application
callout.content: This is NOT an online portal application. Download the application form from the official notification PDF (available at indianarmy.nic.in or Employment News). Fill the form, attach self-attested copies of 10th marksheet, PBX experience certificate, Aadhaar, caste certificate (if applicable), and passport photos. Send everything as email attachments to the official email ID mentioned in the notification (sunshine.rise@nic.in) before May 31, 2026. Subject line format is specified in the notification - follow it exactly.

faqs.question: What is CSBO in the Indian Army?
faqs.answer: CSBO stands for Civilian Switch Board Operator. It's a Group C civilian post under the Ministry of Defence. CSBO operators manage telephone exchanges (PBX/EPABX systems) at Army headquarters, signal training centres, and military establishments across India. You work as a civilian - not a soldier. No military training required.

faqs.question: What is the salary of Army CSBO Grade II?
faqs.answer: Pay Level 3 under 7th CPC - basic pay Rs 21,700. With DA (~50%), HRA (8-24% depending on city), transport allowance, and other benefits, total monthly salary is Rs 33,000-40,000. Additional benefits include CGHS medical for family, canteen access, LTC, and pension under NPS.

faqs.question: Is PBX experience mandatory for CSBO?
faqs.answer: Yes - minimum 6 months of experience in handling PBX (Private Branch Exchange) or EPABX boards is mandatory. You must submit an experience certificate from your previous employer. Without this certificate, your application will be rejected. If you don't have PBX experience, consider gaining it through a short-term course or working at a hotel/office with PBX systems.

faqs.question: Can women apply for Army CSBO posts?
faqs.answer: Yes - women are eligible for CSBO Grade II posts. There is no gender restriction. All Army civilian posts are open to both men and women. The physical standards (height, fitness) applicable to military personnel do NOT apply to civilian posts like CSBO.
